project_type: Next.js 16.4.0 App Router with TypeScript, React 19.3.0, Tailwind CSS 4
build_system: Next.js with Turbopack dev server, npm scripts for build/dev/lint
test_framework: None configured - manual browser testing required
test_command: npm run dev (manual browser verification at http://localhost:3000)
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run build' to verify TypeScript compilation and no build errors. 2. Run 'npm run dev' and manually test each route in browser: / (landing), /booking (all 4 steps). 3. Verify responsive layout on mobile/tablet/desktop viewports. 4. Test timeout modal (wait 9min), navigation guards (back button during booking), and full booking flow completion.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - no snapshot tests or generated code to commit
environment_constraints: Next.js 16.4.0 uses React canary releases (19.3.0) with new JSX transform. AGENTS.md warns this version has breaking changes from training data. Tailwind CSS 4 uses @import and @theme inline syntax in globals.css (no separate config file). Windows PowerShell environment. Logo asset confirmed at public/Amai_Pakpak_Medical_Center_seal.png
contribution_requirements: Read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing code per AGENTS.md. Must use Next.js 16 conventions (LayoutProps type from next, Image/Link from next components). All changes must compile with strict TypeScript. Follow existing component structure and import paths (@/ alias).
key_patterns:
- Layout: Header/Footer in components/layout/, page wrappers use min-h-screen flex flex-col, sticky header top-0 z-50
- Booking flow: Multi-step state machine in app/booking/page.tsx with 4 views (CategorySelector, SchedulePickerView, PatientDetailsView, AppointmentTicketView)
- TypeScript: Strict types from app/types/appointment.ts (AppointmentCategory union, conditional detail types)
- Styling: Tailwind utility classes, emerald-700 brand primary, slate grays for institutional feel, rounded-sm for sharp corners
- Components: Client components use 'use client' directive, server components default
- Navigation: useRouter from next/navigation, Link from next/link
- Images: Next.js Image component with priority for above-fold assets
directory_structure: app/ (Next.js App Router pages & types), components/ (organized by layout/terms/booking domains), public/ (static assets including APMC seal logo), node_modules/next/dist/docs/ (version-specific Next.js documentation)
